children: U.S. outdoor products maker's fiscal Q1 revenue rose 25% yr/yr
Adjusted EPS turned positive from a loss last year
Gross margin expanded to 53.0% from 46.7% yr/yr
Company maintains fiscal 2027 net sales guidance of $200 mln to $210 mln
Company raises fiscal 2027 Adjusted EBITDA guidance to $14.5 mln to $17.5 mln
Company expects seasonally stronger sales in second and third quarters
CATEGORY GROWTH - Co said sales growth was broad-based across Outdoor Lifestyle and Shooting Sports categories, supported by increased sales with largest retail partners
NEW PRODUCTS - Innovation remained a key driver, with new products representing more than 36% of net sales

PRODUCT LAUNCHES AND AWARDS - Launch of Caldwell ClayCopter platform and BUBBA Pro Series Gen 2 Electric Fillet Knife, both recognized by industry awards, contributed to performance and consumer engagement
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 2 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the recreational products peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for American Outdoor Brands Inc is $14.25, about 43.2% above its September 2 closing price of $9.95
The stock recently traded at 16 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 27 three months ago
